text:
Lia (partnerships): Quick sync - we've had requests from two SIs to fast-track onboarding. Proposal: a 1-day cert fast-track + badge for partners who pass automated lab. Thoughts?
Ravi (solutions): I like a fast-track. Need to define the acceptance criteria though. Maybe automated pass for core flows + one manual review.
Becca (pmkt): Badge is great for co-marketing. Can we make a tiered badge (Certified vs Certified+Marketplace)? Also need logo usage guidelines.
Noor (p-success): Operationally, fast-track cohorts make sense but lab capacity is the limiter. Recommend an async lab that runs overnight for perf tests to save seats.
Ethan (eng): We can add a nightly perf job that runs SI-provided images through our benchmark harness. We need image repo access and an HMAC token for the runner.
Lia (partnerships): Good. Let's sketch the fast-track flow: 1) SI submits image + manifest, 2) automated functional + perf tests run, 3) if green -> award "Redwood SI Certified (Fast)" badge and marketplace listing eligibility, 4) one-week probation with sampling QA.
Ravi (solutions): For manifests, require fields: model_variant, quantization, input_shape, sample_prompts, expected_top_k. Add this snippet to the checklist:
```
manifest:
  model_variant: "redwood-7b-fp16"
  quant: "int8-q"
  sample_prompts: ["summarize:", "classify:"]
```
Becca (pmkt): For badge ops: need an internal doc for logo usage, co-brand biography, and an approval step. I can prep a badge spec + email template for press.
Noor (p-success): Training-wise: fast-track should include a 60-90m live QA + 1-2 self-paced lab challenges. We can gate the badge until the SI completes the QA session.
Ethan (eng): Technical notes: perf pass thresholds: p50 < 120ms/token for fp16 on our staging infra, memory < 32GB for 8k context. Also add KV cache stress test under continuous batching.
Lia (partnerships): Great specifics. What about marketplace entitlements and billing credits?
Noor (p-success): Recommend sandbox credits: 1500 credits for fast-track participants, expiration 45 days. We'll track conversion to paid listing after 90 days.
Ravi (solutions): I'll add a small runner script to repo to validate sample_prompts and verify outputs. Example command: `./si-runner --image si/release:latest --manifest manifest.yml`
Becca (pmkt): Also want to collect a short partner story and quote. Fast-track winners get priority in the marketplace featured carousel for 2 weeks. Need legal approval for quotes.
Lia (partnerships): Lia: action items: Ravi = runner + manifest schema; Ethan = perf harness + nightly job; Noor = cohort ops + credits; Becca = badge spec + co-marketing template.
Ravi (solutions): I'll open a draft checklist doc and link it.
Ethan (eng): I'll schedule the nightly runner and add allowlist for partner image push. Need the service account name.
Noor (p-success): I'll prep the signup form and limit initial cohort to 8 SI teams. Also drafting the follow-up conversion play.
Becca (pmkt): I'll loop in legal for quotes and create the badge assets.
partners-bot: Created ticket #4712 for "SI fast-track cert pipeline" and assigned to Ravi, Ethan, Noor, Becca.
Lia (partnerships): One more ask - can we record the live QA and make a short clip for the playbook? Helps later onboarding.
Ravi (solutions): Good idea. I'll host the recording in the shared drive and include short troubleshooting notes.
Ethan (eng): No blockers from infra. Will need exact time window for nightly runs (propose 2-4am PT).
Noor (p-success): 2-4am PT works. That keeps it off-peak for most partners.
Becca (pmkt): I'll draft the co-marketing announcement for the first cohort winners. Expect first draft by Tue.
Lia (partnerships): Thanks everyone. If we can hit these by next Fri, we can pilot the fast-track the following week. :tada:
